pages.text: Some food does not run. Mounds of baked earth. Dead wood full of holes.$(br2)Something lives inside both, in numbers, and it bites whatever pokes at it. A plain stick, patience, and a little repetition turn that into a meal.
Eat what the stick brings back, and you will find you still have the stick. A tool you keep is a technique you can learn.

A mound is not bottomless. Fish it fifteen times and the soldiers seal every hole: it will not open again for two days. Your band and any Paranthropus nearby fish the same mounds.$(br2)Now and then one colony raises three $(l)great mounds$() together, redder and far taller. They never run dry, and every stick comes out heavier.

A colony that size needs its ground left alone. Every block built within thirty blocks of it wears it down, and more every day the building stands - until the colony fails and the great mounds are only mounds.$(br2)A dead tree has two logs worth cracking for grubs, whatever its branches; about half come apart hollow.
